value.rationale: The natural left permutation in a set-theoretic Yang--Baxter brace construction has a complete all-dimension cycle-type invariant. The faithful unitriangular quotient, sharp simultaneous lower bounds on fixed sets of every p-power iterate, including q^(n-1) fixed elements and all minimizers, and exact characteristic-sensitive first maximal-order jump population go beyond existence or an elementary isolated rank check; each is a meaningful structural and arithmetic invariant for the unbounded strict-triangular family.
